VeraGridEngine.Utils.SugiyamaLayered.Phases.components module

Connected components phase for the Sugiyama layered pipeline.

class VeraGridEngine.Utils.SugiyamaLayered.Phases.components.ConnectedComponentsPhase[source]

Bases: LayoutPhaseBase

Detect connected graph components.

name: str = 'connected-components'
run(context: LayoutContext) → None[source]

Execute the connected components phase.

The phase first maps every port to its owner node so edge endpoints can be reduced to a pure node-level adjacency graph. Then it runs one breadth-first search per unvisited node to enumerate the components.

Parameters:

context (LayoutContext) – Shared pipeline context.

Returns:

None.

Return type:

None

VeraGridEngine.Utils.SugiyamaLayered.Phases.long_edges module

Long-edge expansion phase for the Sugiyama layered pipeline.

class VeraGridEngine.Utils.SugiyamaLayered.Phases.long_edges.LongEdgePhase[source]

Bases: LayoutPhaseBase

Split edges that span more than one layer.

name: str = 'long-edges'
run(context: LayoutContext) → None[source]

Execute the long-edge expansion phase.

The phase inserts one dummy node on every intermediate layer crossed by a long edge. That transformation is required so later crossing minimization and coordinate assignment can operate on one proper layer-by-layer graph.

Parameters:

context (LayoutContext) – Shared pipeline context.

Returns:

None.

Return type:

None
